summary: Practise partner controls, change management, and accountable delivery. Explore the five-day community development project management course.
lede: Community development project management coordinates planning and oversight for initiatives shaped by community priorities and defined social outcomes. Designed for project officers, partner coordinators and programme leads, this course builds practical controls for coordinating partners, resources and delivery. You will assess partner readiness, map decision rights with a RACI matrix, manage scope changes, and connect field updates and community feedback to risks, reporting and handover decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate community-led initiatives, partner delivery, local resources, or project accountability and need practical controls for day-to-day implementation.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of project activities, workplans, or partner coordination is expected. No coding or programming is required.
